# IdeasUI

> IdeasUI is a beautiful, accessible, and premium React component library built on React Aria and Tailwind CSS v4.

## Quick Links
- Website: https://ideasui.com
- Repository: https://github.com/ideas2logic-lab/ideasui

## Core Documentation
- [Getting Started](https://ideasui.com/react/docs/start): Overview and architecture of IdeasUI.
- [Installation Guide](https://ideasui.com/react/docs/start/installation): Installing `@ideasui/react` and setting up Tailwind CSS v4.
- [Design Tokens](https://ideasui.com/react/docs/start/tokens): OKLCH semantic color system and token recipes.
- [Dark Mode Integration](https://ideasui.com/react/docs/start/dark-mode): Configuring dynamic light and dark themes.

## Components
- [Button Component](https://ideasui.com/react/docs/components/button): Interactive button with tv() recipes, variants, sizes, and accessibility specs.
- [Button Group](https://ideasui.com/react/docs/components/button-group): Connected button layouts and split-button menus.
